About Dr. Abdulelah Alqahtani

Consultant in Otolaryngology – Head & Neck Surgery, and Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon in Riyadh.

Specialty

Dr. Abdulelah practises as a Consultant ENT and Facial Plastic Surgeon, with a surgical focus on the nose: primary and revision rhinoplasty, septoplasty, and endoscopic sinus surgery, alongside general ear, nose and throat care.

Why the nose?

The nose sits at the centre of the face and is also the gateway for breathing. So he looks at every case from both sides: how the nose looks, and how it works. His ENT background means assessing the airway, septum and turbinates is a core part of every aesthetic plan.

Consultation and planning

Consultations include photography, facial analysis and an illustrative digital simulation that helps doctor and patient agree on a goal. The simulation is a tool for conversation, not a promise of an identical result; tissues differ from person to person.

Current roles

  • Medical Director, Eve Aesthetic Center, Riyadh

Qualifications
